pages.lesson:
LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 5.3.1 WORD CLASSES: ADJECTIVES

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.3: Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication
   In simple words: practise until you can use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives in the examples.
2. Explain Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives.
4. Show that you can: use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in use 5.3.1 Word Classes: Adjectives important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Collaboratively talk about various items in the classroom using adjectives,
2. Describe items using the comparative forms of regular and irregular adjectives with peers,
3. Write correct sentences using comparative forms of adjectives in the right order,
4. Write sentences on tablets, computers and other digital resources using adjectives,
5. Communication and Collaboration: This is developed as the learner uses adjectives correctly in sentences as they interact with peers.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should we say the correct shape and size of things?
2. Which are some of the words you use to talk about how someone feels or looks?
3. How do we describe things?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use adjectives of size and shape in the right order for clarity of communication

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
